title: Archive through March 11, 2004 - Anonymous (Thursday, March 4, 2004 - 08:58 pm)

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Dazed from head blow; strong sense of 'I belong down there' and desire to return to the water/body.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Rapid movement through space with stars streaking like 'warp drive in Star Trek'; later a 'tube of colored light' formed by bubbles culminating in a vortex.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Rapid visual motion without bodily sensation ('no real sensation except for sight'); later compelled movement through colored-light tube to a vortex.

arrival.other_being_detail: Initially encountered a sinister laughing skull and unseen 'dark entities'; later an unseen 'guardian angel' voice; later a robed male figure in a doorway of brilliant white light; also 'three old men in white' at a table/podium.

environment.environment_other_detail: Clouds/space; pitch-black void; multicolored living 'soap bubbles'; a doorway/realm of brilliant white light; white stone/marble table with a gold bowl of dark reflective liquid; pillar/podium and possibly a book.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told to take a message back: 'Man must change his ways' and to 'Spread the message.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning after being struck in the head while rescuing a swimmer during a Boy Scout camp swim test.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Catholic at the time; attended Catholic school (pre-seminary oriented) afterward.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Explicitly states: 'At the time of this near-death experience, I was a Catholic.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Distressing 'hellish' assault by a laughing skull and unseen dark entities; bubbles/tube/vortex imagery; future visions via bowl; request to relinquish paranormal/precognitive powers; preview of future children including one who 'is never born'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above lake → rapid travel through space → pitch-black void with hostile entities → bubbles/tube/vortex → life review with 'guardian angel' voice → doorway of brilliant light with robed figure and other beings → future visions/mission/children preview → forced return to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to 'darkness' multiple times between major segments (after space travel; after hostile encounter; after life review; after leaving the lighted doorway area).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Sinister laughing skull and unseen dark entities that claw/bit him; 'living soap bubbles' filling space; a gold bowl of dark reflective liquid used to view the future of mankind; explicit offer to keep or relinquish paranormal/precognitive powers; preview of future children including one who would not be born (later interpreted as miscarriage).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It is time to review your life experiences." / "You review your life in order to cleanse your soul." / "Your life is evaluated by the most powerful judge there is." ... "That judge is you." / "We have been waiting for you. But, this isn’t your time to be here." / "Look into the bowl and see the future of mankind." / "Man must change his ways." / "Spread the message." / "Do you want these powers you have and the ability to see into the future?"
